title: Abandoned House, Tall Bridge, Campground, Park & Beach/Tidal Wave
content: Gate kid here. Since early childhood, into adulthood, I have always had the same recurring vivid and often times lucid dreams. Anyone else have any similar dreams? **1. Abandoned House** *(similar but not exact to the AI rendering attached)* Some dreams I'd wake up in the middle of the woods, always fall time. I had to find my way to the house. Other times, I was in a black SUV and taken to the woods, and left alone to find my way to the house. I always felt like I was being watched and observed in these dreams. Once at the house, I felt like there was someone in it, and around it, watching and waiting for me. I don't think I ever went inside the house but I'd walk around it. I think the one time I looked into the house, opening the front door, it was all deserted and abandoned feeling, wood rotting. Too scary to go in all the way. https://preview.redd.it/z43d3tac5pwf1.png?width=1536&format=png&auto=webp&s=5166b2950675f01b49313415a0e04570d36d06f7 **2. The Vertical Bridge** *(This AI rendering is not close, but similar to a degree. ChatGPT kept losing connection while I was trying to make changes.)* Always the same dream. Always a child. I'm in the car with my family, we're driving to the beach. The road is normal until we approach the bridge. I always know we're close to it. Once on the bridge, over the water, leaving land, the road goes straight up. No one in the car seems to notice or mind. I begin panicking, I feel dread and my stomach drops. We slowly move upwards and usually right before we drop off, I wake up. I don't know if the bridge stops at the top or continues downward, but I think only once I ever went straight down but woke up at that moment. https://preview.redd.it/8ayq5sqd7pwf1.png?width=1024&format=png&auto=webp&s=660480cfb6bca1a4bc3cf8f459f22daf9752ad96 **3. The Campground** I'm a child in this recurring dream still. I'm on my bike, at a campground. I ride around and around in circles, like I'm going uphill, passing by the camp sites, seeing people. They don't see me and at first I think it's odd, but then I begin to worry. Why don't they see me? Am I dreaming? I keep peddling, and end up exactly where I began. I'm on loop and can't get out of it. Sometimes it feels like I'm on the close top of a mountain, and it's a cone upward to the top. But in the dream, I become frustrated, and try to get people to notice me. I wake up. **4. The Park** Still a child in this dream as well. This is an open park, with trees on the surrounding areas. There are pavilions with people eating, cooking, gathering under them. People all over the park. Trash cans. Horse shoe pits. Volley ball court. People everywhere, but I know no one. I think one time I met another child. I always do the same thing. I look for familiar faces, but I'm content. There are people having a good time. I'm just doing my own thing, but I always do it in the exact same order. **5. The Beach & Tidal Wave** I've been a child, teen and an adult in this dream. I'm usually on a sand dune overlooking the beach, or I'm at the bottom of the sand dune looking out to the water. Many people are there. I have a sense of impeding doom. A few times, there has been someone with me. No one I recognize, but they know me. They stay with me. I know they are familiar. I see a tidal wave approaching, and try to warn people. The wave grows, larger and larger into the sky. People then notice, but it's too late. For years, this is where my dream ended. I woke up in a panic. Recently, over the years, the dream has ended right when I'm turning to run, or I'm facing the wave head on trying to problem solve. Once, the most recent, the wave crashed into me. I died.
